name: mcp-ptitchef
description: MCP server for Ptitchef. Search recipes, browse the category tree, read one with its ingredients and method, rescale it, and cook from what is in the fridge. No API key required.
long_description: Ptitchef browses its recipes by a tree of ingredient families, and every category is addressed by a slug the site writes freely: the same ingredient appears as 'chou-kale' on one line and as 'recette-de-petits-pois' on the next. A slug built by hand therefore reaches a page the site does not hold, which a caller reads as the site holding no such recipes. This server publishes the tree instead, so a category is opened by the name the site gave it. Every answer states what the page listed beside what it rendered, and the entries the site shows beside a family are marked as the excerpt the site prints them to be. Read-only, no API key and no account.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories recipes are browsed by: the families of ingredients, or what one family holds, each with the slug that opens it.

family.description: The slug of a family to open, taken from a previous call. Leave it out to read the families themselves, which is where the tree starts.

limit.description: Entries to render, 20 by default and 200 at most. A level holding more than this says so, and 'categories_published' always states what the page listed.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search recipes by dish or ingredient, and say whether the site answered from a category page of its own or on its own terms.

query.description: A dish or an ingredient, in French, as a reader of the site would type it.

limit.description: Rows to render, 20 by default. 'rows_seen' states what the page served.

tools.name: browse_recipes
tools.description: Read the recipes under one category page by page, or one of the lists the site keeps standing.

category.description: A category slug: one from list_categories whose 'is_family' is false, or the 'topic_slug' a search answered with. A family's slug belongs to list_categories instead.

listing.description: One of the site's standing lists, read instead of a category.

page.description: The page of a category to read. A standing list has one page only.

tools.name: search_by_ingredients
tools.description: Find recipes from one to five ingredients a cook already has, through the site's own fridge search.

ingredients.description: One to 5 ingredients, in French. The site reads no more than that.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Read one recipe: ingredients, method, times, rating, nutrition and the cost the site estimates, rescaled to a number of servings on request.

id.description: The 'id' of a row from a search or a listing, which is the recipe's own page path.

servings.description: Rescale the ingredients to this many servings. Left out, the ingredients come back as published.

tools.name: scale_ingredients
tools.description: Rescale any French ingredient list offline, saying of each line whether the result is exact, rounded to stay usable, or nothing that could be multiplied.

ingredients.description: Ingredient lines, for example ['200 g de farine', '3 oeufs', 'sel'].

factor.description: Multiplier to apply. Use this or the from/to pair.

from_servings.description: How many servings the list is written for.

tools.name: get_recipe_translations
tools.description: List the other languages a recipe was published in, using the pairing the site itself publishes between its editions.

id.description: The 'id' of a row from a search or a listing, which is the recipe's own page path.
